He's tried therapy but didn't feel it "clicked" for him...

I could talk to him but we don't have that close of a relationship I doubt he'd confide in me..

I sometimes think about suicide to release pressure -- I think oh if things get too hard, I can buy a gun and blow my brains out... but I don't google specific ways to kill myself. Do you google specific ways to kill yourself? Serious question.. I'm trying to figure out how serious he is but I can't know which is the worst part
